bareLaunchInvestigation.initialSymptom: Installed/unpacked exe exited immediately with no output
bareLaunchInvestigation.rootCause: ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 was set in the launching shell session (Devin terminal env artifact, not a persistent user/machine env var). The Electron binary ran as plain Node.js: 'bad option' on --user-data-dir is Node's flag parser, and the app exited before main.ts loaded.
bareLaunchInvestigation.fix: packaged-smoke.js already sanitizes NODE_PATH/NODE_OPTIONS/ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE; unsetting the var made the bare launch succeed with full lifecycle: window constructed, server bound, renderer loaded, no crash.
bareLaunchInvestigation.diagnosticEvidence: release/diag-bare.txt full startup lifecycle; process remained running
